therapy life hack teach your clients about countertransference btw as with any of my nonsense rants on this subreddit you dont actually have to do this if its not your style just wanted to share something cool ive noticed while working with my own clients over the years and proffer a new tool to add to your personal clinical toolbox as needed ive been doing this therapist thing for a minute and because i have supervisees im constantly looking for techniques that are both teachable to newer clinicians and easily implementable in session i enjoy playing fast and loose with the structure of psychotherapy my clinical director is very nice to me about it she calls my style an alternative approach so somewhere along the line i began wondering if my clients would respond well to me pulling back the curtain a bit im sitting here analyzing their behavior and speech and mannerisms and looking for ways to go into their cognitive distortions and trauma responses with a bloating needle so i figured it might help build rapport and demystify the process for clients by telling them about transference and eventually countertransference now like selfdisclosure in general i treat this intervention like im a nuclear engineer and its a slightly unstable isotope i usually float it as an observation when i see a client have intense strong emotional responses to something ive said or an intervention were doing transference comes up a lot in parts work ive noticed especially as the younger and more traumatized parts are speaking to me ie hey i think you might be responding this way because im reminding you of person if client agrees and expresses shame dont worry did you know this is totally normal and even expected in therapy its called transference and we can totally run with it and with countertransference i will only keep it neutraltopositive ive told clients before you remind me of my dad or you remind me of me early in my career and then i tell them briefly about countertransference and the neutraltopositive reasons why ive noticed it and loop it right back to the client my dad is a very gentle guy but he does struggle with enabling others harmful behaviors i know struggle with that too you seem to be overworking yourself like i used to and its making you exhausted what are your thoughts on discussing worklife balance strategies for you ive found this work fantastically well in my practice ive had clients tell me its incredibly validating to know that its so normal to inadverdently see your therapist as a standin for your dad or aunt or boss or whomever that theres a wholeass term for it in the field for my clients with romantic or sexual transference towards me theyve said it helps them not feel ashamed for experiencing those feelings and allows them space to explore where theyre missing emotional intimacy in their life and for the countertransference noteits demonstrated to my clients that yes i am their therapist and i have education and training that they do not but i also am a human who makes the same connections in my head about people that they do i want to show my clients that these emotions are not badand that in fact once we call attention to it we can use it as a tool of growth for them okay thats it thanks for entertaining this post yall happy new year may your intake slots be full your insurance reimbursements arrive in your bank account on time and your clients experience lots of healing this year

blacktron scavenger mobile command center salvage unit ive had a few things ive wanted to try in a moc lately i always wanted to build a symmetrical lshaped base like the classic space polaris i space lab i always wanted to put the blacktron message intercept bases large black and yellow angled domes together so clever that lego didnt do that in the original set allowing kids to figure that out for themselves finally i always wanted to make a blacktron vehicle using the gold angled dome as a windshield just like the mtron mega core magnetizer then i thought what if i could do all three of those things in one moc and with a transformation of purely mechanical moving parts no taking things off and putting them back on i present to you the blacktron scavenger mobile command center salvage unit the main vehicle opens up and transforms into a command center allowing the salvager to roam out and explore the landscape looking for wrecks there were some interesting challenges with getting the angles of the command center right as a vehicle the bottoms of the big black dome pieces used are perpendicular to the sides of the vehicle to form fenders but as a base the sides rotate out 45 degrees and the bottoms of the dome pieces have to reach up and rotate in 45 degrees some technic gear work makes both of these things happen at the same time and then the black dome pieces snap into place with the yellow dome piece getting the center portion which is at a 45 degree angle to the rest of the vehicle to lay nicely on the sides when in vehicle mode was tricky note the black castle walls i ran tubes through them to make them some kind of interesting hatch the salvager has several tools at its disposal to recover scraps from wrecked ships the front features a shovel to push things out of the way the middle segment has an articulating scoop and two tool bays for scrap workers and the back features a dump bucket as well as a winch to drag anything too large to carry the cockpit at front can detach to function as a spaceship blacktron tech always incorporates some sneaky modularity the rugged tubebased suspension system allows for climbing over whatever gets in the way unconfirmed space police intelligence suggests that the scavenger uses its large dish to scramble ship scanners and communications increasing the likelihood of ship crashes nearby but every time the salvager shows up at a wreck the smiley blacktron team just wants to help clean up theyre always eager to recycle anything that cant be saved how kind hmm

bad first impression between anxious resident cat and new oblivious cat how to move forward without everyone getting frustrated looking for advice on how to move forward after a bad introduction ive been reading just about every introduction post i can find but felt like i needed specific advice for our circumstances our main characters today are irma resident 8 yo anxious scared of any toys that arent just a string franklin new initiate 2 yo orange irma came to us after she was rehomed separately from the other kitties in her household because she was bullied by them and didnt get along we got franklin to keep her company because she seems to want to play with us as if we were cats biting wrestling chasing etc our first mistake was in how we brought him home ive had cats my whole life so i should have known better but the woman at the shelter was of the old school let them figure it out camp and gave us the advice to not separate them huge mistake irma hissed at him until she was basically snorting and our resident orange boy just ignored her and kept exploring he wasnt aggressive at all but he also didnt listen at all to her boundaries we did end up separating them after that but weve been dealing with the fallout of that encounter ever since in the ensuing divorce new boy got the bedroom since it has an actual door on it and she got the living roomkitchen combo to appease our resident who sleeps with us at night one of us started sleeping in the living room each night so she doesnt feel too upset were on day 5 now and franklin is ready to leave he cries if no one is in here with him and tries to escape at every opportunity ive let him on the balcony and into the bathroom to explore new places every once in a while but hes not satisfied with this and honestly i dont blame him the problem is irma is not interested in going anywhere near this room she wont even go into the hallway leading to the bedroom anymore she is not particularly food motivated and eats less when shes stressed so trying to get her anywhere closer is a losing battle weve been working on scent training which has been going okay but its not easing her anxiety toward the space or him i know eventually it will all be okay my family introduced dozens of cats into our household but this is my first time doing it alone and my first time doing it with a solo cat i know cat introductions take a long time but im not sure how to manage quality of life of new kitty who has a pretty small space to exist in while we wait for resident kitty to come around anyone have any advice or reassurance tldr anxious resident kitty is so scared of new kitty after initial bad first impression that she wont come anywhere near new kittys home base training with food hasnt been working and new kitty is ready to leave home base asap what do i do to facilitate this a bit more smoothly

predicting mental state request for feedback on my approach to clarify the goal is to create a model that monitors a classic llm providing the most accurate answer possible and that this model can be used clinically both for monitoring and to see the impact of a factor x on mental health hello everyone im 19 years old please be gentle im writing because id like some critical feedback on my predictive modeling methodology without going into the pure technical implementation the exact result or the specific data i usedyes im too lazy to go into that context i founded a mental health startup two years ago and i want to develop a proprietary predictive model to clarify the terminology i use individual a model focused on a single subject precision medicine global a populationbased model thousandsmillions of individuals for public health note i am aware that this separation is probably artificial since what works for one should theoretically apply to the other but it simplifies my testing phases furthermore each approach has a different objective here are the different avenues im exploring 1 the causal and semantic approach influenced by judea pearl an individual approach where the goal is solely to answer the question of the best psychological response not really to predict my first attempt was the use of causal vectors the objective was to constrain embedding models already excellent semantically to understand causality the observation i tested this on a dataset of 50k examples the result is significant but suffers from the same flaw as classic llms its fundamentally about correlation not causality the model tends to look for the nearest neighbor in the database rather than understanding the underlying mechanism the missing theoretical contribution judea pearl this is where the approach needs to be enriched by the work of judea pearl and her ladder of causality currently my model remains at level 1 association seeing what is to predict effectively in mental health it is necessary to reach level 2 intervention doing and seeing and especially level 3 counterfactual imagining what would have happened if decisionmaking advantage despite its current predictive limitations this approach remains the most robust for clinical decision support it offers crucial explainability for healthcare professionals understanding why the model suggests a particular risk is more important than the raw prediction 2 the dynamic systems statespace approach physics of suffering individual approach this is an approach for the individual level inspired by materials science and systems control the concept instead of predicting a single event we model psychological stability using statespace modeling the mechanism we mathematically distinguish the hidden state real invisible suffering from observations noisy statistics such as suicide rates this allows us to filter the signal from the noise and detect tipping points where the distortion of the homeostatic curve becomes irreversible whatif simulation unlike a simple statistical prediction this model allows us to simulate causal scenarios eg what happens if we inject a shock of magnitude x at t2 by directly disrupting the internal state of the system i tried it my model isnt great 3 the graph neural networks gnn approach global level holistic approach for the population scale i explore graphs structure representing clusters of individuals connected to other clusters propagation analyzing how an event affecting a group eg collective trauma economic crisis spreads to connected groups through social or emotional contagion 4 multiagent simulation agentbased modeling global approach here the equation is simple 1 agent 1 human the idea to create a digital twin of society this is a simulation governed by defined rules economic political social calibration the goal is to test these rules on past events backtesting if the simulation deviates from historical reality the model rules are corrected 5 time series analysis lstm transformers global approach mental health evolves over time unlike static embeddings these models capture the sequential nature of events the order of symptoms is as important as the symptoms themselves i trained a model on public data number of hospitalizations number of suicides etc its interesting but extremely abstract i was able to make my model match but the underlying fundamentals were weak so rather than letting an ai guess we explicitly code the sociology into the variables eg calculating the decay of traumatic memory of an event social inertia cyclical seasonality therefore it also depends on the parameters given to the causal approach but it works reasonably well if you need me to send you more details feel free to ask none of these approaches seem very conclusive i need your feedback

eylanor history is a spell the world is a glyph time is a spiral hi i am really nervous to actually post this here but i guess every world building project needs some external feedback after all a friend and i basically worked this world out for 10 years the original material is in german our primary language i tried to best summarize and translate the world for this board video essays in german can be found here if there is interest i am going to split this into several chapters part 1 will deal with the cosmology and magic system part 2 geography and peoples part 3 history and religion etc etc i would love a broad feedback here goes nothing chapter i cosmology every birth already carries the memory of its end from the augural annals of the iceseers of nepheril in the beginning there lay a sea of possibility soundless boundless glittering like nightfrost on black glass from that depth rose a gesture so old that every later name would be only the dull echo of an echo by now even the last echo has faded and been forgotten infinity without form is also without meaning the nameless gesture set patterns into the joints between possibilities potential gained direction direction congealed into law first the firmament darkened then the stars rose to watch whether the rules of the new world would be obeyed and they still watch this cosmos is threaded through by three forces that recur in everything in the heart of a mountain in the meaning of a prayer in the course of a life the primal people named these forces arcana arcana is no supernatural energy no metaphysical field hovering above reality no dimension beneath or beside or between the skeleton of creation no reflection no illusion no foreign power arcana is the ground of everything the quintessence of eylanor it arises from what is called aether the primordial state of the universe existing before the worlds order only with the emergence of arcana does meaning appear because decisions acquire consequences time space mind and life can come into being every race of eylanor in their exploration of this arcane system eventually discovered that three fundamental currents run through it binding flow essence binding is the sphere of the material yet also of oaths laws and traditions culturally speaking alchemy biomancy and craft belong to this sphere its universal symbol is often the very core of eylanor itself flow is the sphere of motion whatever flows is assigned to flow water time gravity even the breath of the living essence is the sphere of mind and soul essence bears the spark from which being will and self awaken in nature the three arcana spheres repel each other the purer they appear to fuse pure essence with pure flow without the control of a mighty mage would end for instance in a detonation of shattered dreams and splintered memory and yet eylanor exists eylanor exists precisely where the three arcana spheres overlap and form a stable enduring reaction just as a mage can force conflicting arcana into stable synergy on a smaller scale something greater forces eylanor to exist who or what that force is this is one of the central questions of eylanorian cosmology the very existence of pure arcana implies the existence of limit conditions seen from farther out the arcana spheres are more than conceptual energies from which the fabric of reality is woven they condense into actual domains surrounding eylanor arcana realms there are three paragon realms one for each sphere mages have always sought to reach them yet no reliable record exists of anyone entering their deepest strata and returning in addition there are six socalled peripheral realms where one sphere diffuses into its neighbor these borderstates of being are unstable from eylanor they are easier to enter though returning in one piece may prove more difficult each peripheral realm lies at the interface of two paragon realms none contains the purest highest forms of both arcana at once thus eylanor remains unique a full union of three complete spheres on this world all expressions of arcana exist from profane everyday magic to godlike purity the most widespread group of inhabitants are the eylanori details later for now this much every eylanori carries the cosmology of their world in miniature within themselves eylanori are living breathing stable reactions between the three spheres their physical bodies represent binding their path through life represents flow their minds and souls represent essence but the soul requires further explanation the eylanori teach the triune soul they call the undersoul what we ordinarily mean by i the living embodied soul anchored in flesh and time bordered by language shaped by action the undersoul is local it is written by the individuals choices it is where consciousness and spirituality become indistinguishable it is a line and each person sets its points above this line rests the oversouln the higher self in serelys the paragon realm of essence there the higher self administers the loops of becoming after mortal death the oversoul reabsorbs the undersoul filters patterns and imprints compiles them and from these weaves future life the oversoul is structured in eternal circles almost algorithmic in its refinement of soul above both lies the metasoul some say eylanors sun is its seat a radiant wonder that grants life and at once a cosmic furnace the metasoul transcends individuality time and place it is the condensation of all other souls of all experience all patterns all narratives all archetypes what is forged in its eternal fire what insight is meant to be distilled another mystery of this legendary world many a philosopher has looked up at night to the stars those suns of other worlds and wondered whether they were looking back this is eylanors cosmos a work of lines and circles a threefold chord whose balance should not exist and yet does an invisible hand has forged it an incomprehensible will guides its history the firmament of this world has eyes where other worlds have stars whoever lives beneath this sky serves first not a land a banner a name but a poem that wrestles in every generation for its final line and somewhere where a path of grass becomes stone waits the moment when a single soul closes its grip or opens the hand in that gesture lies the whole cosmology chapter ii the magic system we never built machines to replace magic we built them so magic could measure itself technology is the democratization of arcana proof that wonders can be made reproducible without ceasing to be wonders from the manifesto of the fhir mironin the general principle of magic in eylanor was already laid out in the chapter on cosmology the peoples of eylanor especially the eylanori translated these natural laws into an operational system that permeates cultures and customs across the world in its modern form it was first codified by the philosopher and universal genius kysador of caedin we will hear much more of him broadly speaking the system moves along two dimensions arcana discipline and arcana refinement disciplines are practical applications of the spheres enchanting ones armor to resist impact belongs to binding discipline obscuring an enemys mind belongs to essence slowing time belongs to flow in keeping with the axioms of eylanors cosmology the disciplines do not naturally interact on the contrary a clear correlation of strengths and weaknesses can be observed flow magic is often effective against essence magic its volatile adaptability can break the focus essence requires essence magic counters binding binding relies on stable facts and rules anchored in the physical illusions and perceptionwarping can unseat a binding mage binding counters flow a strong binding caster can slow or halt what moves water wind time itself even information along nerves using these interactions in conflict is called dissonance wise mages learn the basics of all three disciplines so they can respond flexibly alongside dissonances there are synergies the art of coexistence just as some hidden force compels eylanor and the eylanori into stable being mages can combine disciplines into stable effects these are advanced techniques natural dissonance must be overcome twosphere unions are relatively common threesphere fusions are exceedingly rare such spells are called arcana symphonies reserved for absolute masters who appear only in small numbers each generation some innovators discovered a shortcut volatile synergies intentional partially controlled dissonance effects these spells do not aim for stability they weaponize instability a spell that merges flow and essence just long enough to reach the core of an enemy force may detonate there into an unpredictable effect of crushing gravity and broken spacetime across discipline runs refinement refinement rests on a cosmological fact the arcana spheres exist along a spectrum of purity the purer the arcana the more potent it becomes but also the harder to control and the more prone to catastrophic dissonance when contacting other arcana magic scales in three refinements profane is everyday use the baker who binds dough and convinces it to rise with a word the fisher who shifts a current with a gesture the student who defragments their own mind before an exam sublime is mastery the bridge whose loadbearing is negotiated with topology the sorcerer who argues with the sky until a storm agrees to arrive the mentalist whose thoughts overwrite others transcendent is legend floating cities the erasure of entire peoples by removing them from time political systems decided not at ballot boxes but between consciousness and subconsciousness of every citizen the price of magic is not energy in the simple sense a mage may possess what could be called an arcana reservoir but it is not a stockpile of supernatural power it is the limit of imagination on the one side and on the other side the worlds willingness to bend the less plausible a spell is within current causality the more it demands of the caster to learn higher arcana means to internalize philosophically what those primal forces signify for what holds the world together in this sense magic is also science the more the mage understands the more subtly and the more vastly they can manipulate reality translated into our world only someone who conceptually grasps nuclear fission could split an atom by spell and create a nuclear weapon spell in eylanor it means whoever has absorbed the nature of one or more disciplines can perform wonders yet if the mind focuses too exclusively on one discipline an ontological price follows a mind lost in essence sees the world only through essence logic other arcana become harder to learn until one day they cannot be learned at all why you might ask would peoples in a world full of magic develop technology why sharpen stone when you can stop an animals heart with a gesture why invent a bow when lightning can be thrown why forge a steel shield when one of arcana seems so much nearer eylanors technological history has two notable roots and it is inseparable from the magic system first because deeper understanding makes spells stronger the world breeds curiosity science becomes almost inevitable to understand a stone is to realize it can also be used as a tool to grasp air and gravity is to arrive quickly at ballistics but why use those side insights at all here enters the second factor technology is a magic multiplier these concepts do not contradict they complement they are both aspects of reality and thus it is logical to bind them together in practice a sword cuts a blade spell cuts a sword carrying a blade spell cuts better so far that even a sophisticated suthumic crystalsplinter rifle with a profane enchantment can pierce a sublime defensive ward technology multiplies arcana especially in regions where magic is scarce thus the greatest technological breakthroughs occurred on the arcanapoor southern continent suthum magic in eylanor is therefore a negotiation with reality to cast is to propose a version of the world you want to be true and if the world allows itself to be persuaded it becomes true power emerges where binding flow and essence are forced into a single statement the price is authorship and eylanors magic exacts a steep price one that does not primarily manifest as wounds of flesh or mind worse it demands an epistemological tribute the more power you gain the narrower becomes the corridor of what you can still imagine doing with it thus the guiding question for every mage must remain do we write history or are we being written

predicting mental state request for feedback on my approach to clarify the goal is to create a model that monitors a classic llm providing the most accurate answer possible and that this model can be used clinically both for monitoring and to see the impact of a factor x on mental health hello everyone im 19 years old please be gentle im writing because id like some critical feedback on my predictive modeling methodology without going into the pure technical implementation the exact result or the specific data i usedyes im too lazy to go into that context i founded a mental health startup two years ago and i want to develop a proprietary predictive model to clarify the terminology i use individual a model focused on a single subject precision medicine global a populationbased model thousandsmillions of individuals for public health note i am aware that this separation is probably artificial since what works for one should theoretically apply to the other but it simplifies my testing phases furthermore each approach has a different objective here are the different avenues im exploring 1 the causal and semantic approach influenced by judea pearl an individual approach where the goal is solely to answer the question of the best psychological response not really to predict my first attempt was the use of causal vectors the objective was to constrain embedding models already excellent semantically to understand causality the observation i tested this on a dataset of 50k examples the result is significant but suffers from the same flaw as classic llms its fundamentally about correlation not causality the model tends to look for the nearest neighbor in the database rather than understanding the underlying mechanism the missing theoretical contribution judea pearl this is where the approach needs to be enriched by the work of judea pearl and her ladder of causality currently my model remains at level 1 association seeing what is to predict effectively in mental health it is necessary to reach level 2 intervention doing and seeing and especially level 3 counterfactual imagining what would have happened if decisionmaking advantage despite its current predictive limitations this approach remains the most robust for clinical decision support it offers crucial explainability for healthcare professionals understanding why the model suggests a particular risk is more important than the raw prediction 2 the dynamic systems statespace approach physics of suffering individual approach this is an approach for the individual level inspired by materials science and systems control the concept instead of predicting a single event we model psychological stability using statespace modeling the mechanism we mathematically distinguish the hidden state real invisible suffering from observations noisy statistics such as suicide rates this allows us to filter the signal from the noise and detect tipping points where the distortion of the homeostatic curve becomes irreversible whatif simulation unlike a simple statistical prediction this model allows us to simulate causal scenarios eg what happens if we inject a shock of magnitude x at t2 by directly disrupting the internal state of the system i tried it my model isnt great 3 the graph neural networks gnn approach global level holistic approach for the population scale i explore graphs structure representing clusters of individuals connected to other clusters propagation analyzing how an event affecting a group eg collective trauma economic crisis spreads to connected groups through social or emotional contagion 4 multiagent simulation agentbased modeling global approach here the equation is simple 1 agent 1 human the idea to create a digital twin of society this is a simulation governed by defined rules economic political social calibration the goal is to test these rules on past events backtesting if the simulation deviates from historical reality the model rules are corrected 5 time series analysis lstm transformers global approach mental health evolves over time unlike static embeddings these models capture the sequential nature of events the order of symptoms is as important as the symptoms themselves i trained a model on public data number of hospitalizations number of suicides etc its interesting but extremely abstract i was able to make my model match but the underlying fundamentals were weak so rather than letting an ai guess we explicitly code the sociology into the variables eg calculating the decay of traumatic memory of an event social inertia cyclical seasonality therefore it also depends on the parameters given to the causal approach but it works reasonably well if you need me to send you more details feel free to ask none of these approaches seem very conclusive i need your feedback

why quiet bookings build stronger hosts in the shortterm rental world noise is often mistaken for success fully booked calendars constant inquiries rapid turnovers and endless notifications are celebrated as proof that a host is doing well but experienced hosts know a quieter truth not all bookings are equal quiet bookings the ones that arrive without frantic messaging lastminute chaos or emotional drain are often the foundation of longterm success these bookings dont shout they dont rush they dont overwhelm instead they stabilize income protect energy and build trust at llivo this philosophy is intentional the platform was never designed to reward noise or volume alone its roots reflected in the story of llivo are grounded in dignity balance and humancentered hosting quiet bookings arent accidental theyre a signal that a host has built something sustainable this article explains why quiet bookings create stronger hosts and why chasing volume without intention often does the opposite quiet bookings signal the right guests when bookings arrive calmly and confidently it usually means one thing the guest already trusts the listing quiet bookings tend to come from guests who read listings carefully respect house rules communicate clearly and concisely book with intention not panic these guests dont require constant reassurance because the listing itself has done its job that doesnt happen by luck it happens through clarity honesty and consistency over time hosts who attract these guests spend less time managing emotions and more time delivering quality experiences less noise means better decisionmaking highvolume booking environments often push hosts into reactive mode pricing decisions become rushed guest screening becomes shallow burnout becomes normalized quiet bookings create space for thoughtful communication fair stable pricing better preparation between stays emotional bandwidth for real hosting strong hosts are not reactive hosts they are intentional hosts and intention requires calm quiet calendars often hide stronger revenue a calendar filled edgetoedge can look impressive but it often masks hidden costs cleaning fatigue maintenance shortcuts strained communication and declining guest experience quiet bookings frequently involve longer stays fewer turnovers lower operational costs higherquality reviews when hosts stop measuring success by occupancy alone and start measuring it by net stability the picture changes quickly this is especially relevant for hosts positioning themselves as a vacation rental agency usa that values longterm trust over shortterm spikes trustbased platforms attract quiet bookings guests who book quietly are often avoiding platforms that feel transactional unpredictable or aggressive they gravitate toward environments where transparency is normal and pressure is absent llivos model supports this shift by emphasizing honest listings clear expectations human communication predictable experiences this approach aligns naturally with hosts who want fewer better stays rather than constant churn for insight into building trust through communication explore relationship with renters quiet hosting protects the hosts identity many hosts enter shortterm rentals for freedom flexibility or purpose not to become fulltime crisis managers loud booking cycles slowly erode that original intention quiet bookings help hosts preserve personal time maintain emotional balance avoid resentment toward guests host with dignity instead of exhaustion a burnedout host cannot provide warm hospitality no matter how optimized the listing is this is why strong hosts think longterm not just quarterly quality guests create quality reviews guests who book calmly tend to review thoughtfully their feedback is specific fair and emotionally balanced over time these reviews build a reputation that attracts similar guests creating a selfreinforcing cycle this is how hosts move from survival mode into authority mode within the shortterm vacation rentals company ecosystem a reputation built quietly lasts longer than a reputation built loudly policies and boundaries matter more than popularity hosts chasing volume often soften boundaries to avoid losing bookings hosts attracting quiet bookings do the opposite they clarify boundaries upfront clear policies reduce friction misunderstandings and emotional labor they also attract guests who value structure and respect for guidance on setting and maintaining healthy hosting boundaries see policies and best practices quiet bookings reflect mature hosting there is a phase in every hosts journey where growth is loud experimentation learning trial and error but maturity is quiet mature hosts know their audience price confidently communicate selectively say no when needed quiet bookings are not a lack of demand they are evidence of alignment why this matters now more than ever search engines travelers and platforms are shifting volumefirst strategies are becoming unstable trustfirst strategies are compounding hosts who position themselves as the best vacation rental agency in the usa are not chasing noise they are building systems that attract the right guests repeatedly this is where llivos philosophy stands firm hosting should be human sustainable and respectful of both sides learn more about this vision here about llivo final words quiet bookings dont flatter the ego but they strengthen the host they protect time energy reputation and purpose hosts who understand this stop chasing noise and start building something durable this is not about doing less its about doing better at llivo quiet success is not an accident its the outcome of trust clarity and humanity values that dont need to shout to be heard

the american dream 20 why more professionals are choosing latin america over us hubs for most of modern history the path to opportunity pointed toward the united states you moved to big cities chased higher salaries and paid the price of entry through long commutes rising rents and a lifestyle that rarely slowed down but in the era of remote work that story is evolving today more professionals are discovering geographic arbitrage earning in dollars while living in places where their money stretches further buying not just nicer apartments or better meals but time freedom and mental space and nowhere is that shift more visible than in the growing movement from us hubs like miami and austin to latin american capitals such as mexico city medelln and buenos aires whats really driving the shift this trend isnt simply about escaping high prices its about reclaiming hours once lost to traffic lowering the pressure to constantly grind surrounding yourself with culture and community prioritizing life over lifestyle branding in many latin american cities the cost of living is still meaningfully lighter that difference creates breathing room the space to slow down create and build something meaningful without the constant financial sprint mexico city global creative completely alive mexico city has become a true global magnet treelined neighborhoods offer cafs worldclass dining galleries creative communities and a feeling of momentum its cosmopolitan without being sterile ambitious without being frantic the city blends oldworld charm with modern infrastructure and for many remote workers it delivers the energy of a major capital without the constant financial tension found in us metro areas people dont just move here to save they move because life feels richer per hour lived medelln lifestyle as a feature not a luxury medelln represents the dream of what life looks like when quality is built into the environment endless spring weather walkable social neighborhoods a culture that values connection over busyness coworking spaces that feel like communities a slower more human rhythm yes the city is changing as more foreigners arrive and conversations about impact and responsibility are important but for those earning in stronger currencies life here offers something rare ambition without burnout you can work hard but you dont have to live hard just to keep up buenos aires romance culture and beautiful chaos buenos aires is a paradox elegant unpredictable passionate and endlessly creative it offers a europeanstyle cultural life at a fraction of the emotional cost of american hustle culture long dinners bookstores everywhere music in the streets and a social life that values presence over productivity its not always simple the system can be chaotic paperwork matters things change quickly but for those who can embrace uncertainty the city rewards you with soul the real arbitrage isnt money its time heres the heart of the story in many us cities maintaining a normal professional life now requires constant hustle long hours high stress and little room to breathe in much of latin america that same income level buys free time lower stress community creativity agency it allows people to work on their own projects instead of simply working to stay afloat the psychological shift is huge from survival mode to designing your life intentionally this isnt a fairy tale there are tradeoffs distance from family new languages cultural adjustment legal and visa considerations responsibility to be a respectful guest and yes life abroad requires selfawareness and humility but for many remote workers the equation now feels clear if you can earn from anywhere why not live somewhere that gives you more life per day the new definition of opportunity the original american dream was about movement going where possibility was greatest today that possibility may exist far beyond us borders for a growing number of professionals the dream isnt about having more its about needing less to live well sometimes the smartest financial decision is also the most human one and increasingly that means looking south not out of escape but out of intention and if you enjoy clear calm economic storytelling without hype or forecasts i explore these structural themes daily here on thanks as always for reading disclaimer turning the page at savvy gardens at savvy gardens we came into this space with a simple intention to build genuine community share knowledge and encourage curiosity and healing from the beginning we have poured time energy and heart into creating spaces where people could learn ask questions feel welcomed and grow alongside us we have run giveaways shared educational resources answered countless messages and offered knowledge freely because we truly wanted to support others we did these things long before there was any promise of recognition or support in return over time though we noticed something change what began as appreciation slowly turned into expectation once information is given freely it can start to be treated as something owed for that reason we have stepped back from giving out free information in the same way we once did we want to be clear savvy gardens is not a nonprofit we do not operate on grants or pooled donations we are a business that we built through years of personal work risk investment loss and learning our livelihood depends on valuing our products our time and our expertise we believe it is fair to acknowledge that while we care deeply about community we cannot sustain a model where everything is expected for free along the way we have also encountered politics gatekeeping and environments where belonging seemed to depend on paying fees or sacrificing our boundaries we have been asked for our genetics our work and our contributions in ways that did not reflect mutual respect or support those experiences have shaped how we move forward even with all of that we still believe in healing curiosity responsible education and earned understanding we dont believe exploration or conversation around these topics should be owned or controlled by any one person entity or government at the same time we believe the knowledge and work involved should be respected the medicine is earned not taken for granted fruit of thy labor moving forward we are choosing to focus on authentic inperson connections with people who value reciprocity and integrity our community will continue to grow just not in spaces that expect us to give endlessly while receiving little support in return love and happiness come from within and we remain committed to growing with people who understand that

10 fun morning affirmations for kids to start their day with confidence these 10 fun morning affirmations for kids help boost confidence improve mood and make it easier to start the day with a positive calm mindset 10 fun morning affirmations for kids to start their day with confidence 1 mirror starting affirmations in front of the mirror is simple but surprisingly fun for kids using the mirror creates a personal connection as they see themselves making those positive words feel even more genuine you can make mirror time more engaging with just a few steps have your child stand or sit so they can see their face clearly in the mirror post a bright card near the mirror with their favorite affirmation written on it encourage them to smile at themselves before they begin say the affirmation out loud together youd be surprised how much energy a big smile adds to their words if you want to mix things up add physical movements like stretching arms wide clapping or even doing a silly dance as suggested by using morning affirmations creatively some effective affirmations for mirror time 1 i am brave and ready for anything 2 i make positive choices for myself 3 i am kind to others and myself giving a few extra minutes at the mirror every morning isnt just about confidence it can seriously boost your childs mood and help set their focus for the whole day 2 breakfast table mornings at home can be quite hectic but the breakfast table is a surprisingly good place to start the day with positive affirmations while everyone is munching on their cereal or toast take a moment for each person to say one positive thing about themselves or the day ahead this isnt about perfection or big speeches just a little boost to help everyone feel more prepared to face whatever comes their way heres an easy way to make breakfast affirmations a habit 1 go around the table and have each person share a quick positive statement out loud kids can use simple phrases like i am kind or i can handle tough things 2 if talking isnt everyones thing write an affirmation on an index card and place it on the table rotating a new one each day 3 mix things up with different themes mondays for courage wednesdays for gratitude and so on it keeps things fresh and gives kids something to look forward to some families share something theyre grateful for or excited about at breakfast which is another great way to connect before a busy day theres more about that practice on helping to foster connection and positivity kids may grumble sometimes but over time these quick breakfast table affirmations become natural habits that they carry with them even when theyre older 3 toothbrush brushing teeth may seem boring to most kids but what if it became a strong confidence booster turning your childs daily tooth brushing into an affirmation moment can make mornings both practical and positive while your child stands at the sink with their toothbrush in hand they have a few minutes to practice friendly selftalk that sets a positive tone for the day ahead heres an easy way to incorporate affirmations into your brushing routine 1 write short upbeat affirmations like i am brave today is a fresh start or i do my best on a sticky note near the bathroom mirror 2 while brushing encourage your child to say these affirmations aloud yes even with toothpaste foam or they can whisper or think the words quietly if they feel shy 3 sometimes turn it into a game can they finish the affirmation before the brush timer runs out kids enjoy a playful routine and linking positive selftalk to a daily habit helps affirmations stick older children might prefer changing the affirmation weekly or writing their own message on the mirror with an erasable marker combining this with a mindfulness practice like taking a few deep belly breaths before starting is a fantastic way to add simple mindfulness for children into their morning routine without any extra fuss 4 sticky notes starting the day with encouraging words doesnt have to be complicated one simple way for kids to see positive affirmations first thing in the morning is by using sticky notes putting sticky notes with uplifting messages around the house can make affirmations feel enjoyable and natural not like a chore heres how to maximize the use of sticky notes for morning affirmations let your child help write their own affirmations on sticky notes so they feel personal and special pick colorful notes add stickers or doodles it makes the messages stand out and adds a touch of excitement place the notes where your child sees them every day their bedroom mirror on the bathroom wall in their closet or even by their breakfast plate some families even change their messages weekly keeping things fresh and giving everyone something new to anticipate you can choose from a collection of uplifting phrases or create your own like i can solve problems or i am proud of who i am if you want to mix things up try rotating messages or pulling from a prewritten affirmation jar for lunches or backpacks as mentioned in these sticky note message ideas 5 stuffed animal stuffed animals arent just for hugs at bedtime they can also play a big part in a kids morning routine too starting the day with a positive affirmation to a favorite stuffed friend can make the words feel safe fun and genuine kids often open up to their plush animals in ways they might not with others sharing their worries and practicing bravery in a safe environment heres an easy way to turn your childs stuffed animal into a morning affirmation pal 1 let your child choose their favorite stuffed animal to sit with them every morning 2 encourage them to look at the stuffed animal and say one positive sentence about themselves such as i am brave i am a good friend or i can try new things today 3 for some extra support ask your child to gently give the toy a small squeeze after saying their affirmation as if theyre locking in the good feeling you can also vary the routine from time to time maybe the stuffed animal gets to wear a special scarf for affirmation day or your kid can pick a new positive phrase from a jar this keeps things fresh so kids want to return to the practice each morning these little rituals much like morning meditation routines help establish consistent habits 6 coloring markers coloring markers arent just for art class they can also be a secret weapon for making affirmations something children look forward to every morning kids love to get creative and letting them write or decorate their own affirmations with colorful markers turns the whole process into an art project rather than just another task heres how to use coloring markers to enhance your childs affirmation routine 1 choose simple powerful affirmations together like i am brave i try my best or i am a good friend 2 give your child a set of markers and some colorful paper 3 have them write the affirmation in their own words with bubble letters or even pictures 4 encourage them to doodle add stickers or underline their favorite words 5 post these mini masterpieces in places your child will see every day the bedroom door fridge or backpack transforming affirmations into a vibrant interactive activity can help kids remember and use positive selftalk throughout the day if you want to deepen this practice using tools like affirmation cards can make the activity more engaging and boost confidence and a positive mindset throughout the day check out more ideas on how affirmation cards use positive statements to support mental health 7 backpack before heading out the door take a moment to slip an affirmation into your childs backpack this small gesture can provide them with a secret boost of confidence during the school day all it takes is a colorful note or a small card with a positive message tucked into a side pocket heres how to make the morning backpack affirmation meaningful write a new short and ageappropriate note each day for your child use fun stickers or drawings to attract younger kids attention for older children customize the message to address challenges they might encounter such as a test or a busy day some ideas for backpack affirmations might include 1 you are brave and capable of handling anything today brings 2 im proud of you for consistently giving your best 3 you make your friends smile never forget that creating family rituals like morning affirmations that emphasize special qualities can help your child stand tall even on tough days keep it simple make it frequent and watch those small notes foster greater confidence 8 gratitude journal getting kids to write a little each morning in a gratitude journal isnt as hard as it seems in fact it might quickly become one of their favorite parts of the day a gratitude journal is a small notebook or just a few sheets of paper where your child writes or draws things theyre thankful for this simple habit helps kids begin their day noticing the good even if they wake up feeling grumpy or nervous about something why should children keep a gratitude journal it shifts their focus to positive things such as a fun game at recess or their favorite breakfast they learn to appreciate small moments which helps balance out any worries they have about school or friends kids improve at expressing their feelings making it feedback loops that distort perception or inflate hubris we have today alot of tools outinside of us and more opportunitys mirrors and spaces for reflection than we acknowledge emergence shows us how intent can remain aligned even when methods differ much like the polarity of letting go and acceptance in daoist thought if feedbackloops i also call impulses inumen outomen movement is visible yet its essence is guided by orientation calibration and resonancewith the larger system with relations and with responsibility we can trace these patterns through history philosophy and cultural practice the teachings of lord shiva kabbalah alchemy the secret of the golden flower the seven liberal arts and ancient greek wisdom all offer lenses to observe motion and emotion power and influence the devouring aspect of the collective unconscious an echo of the face of absolute evil while the shadow can be said to straddle the personal and collective unconscious with aspects that relate specifically to us as individuals as well as to groups and societies at large the soul imageanimaanimus is seated directly in the collective unconscious mike hockney went on to say the soul image is a mediator a gobetween which establishes communication between the conscious ego and the collective unconscious and helps reconcile the two the shadow does not perform this role because it is primarily concerned with elucidating the personal unconscious as we illuminate the contents of our personal unconscious via the shadow we can more and more see the entrance to the collective unconscious take shape the soul image is the entrance in jungian individuation jung described the animaanimus as figures that fascinate seduce and inspire they are not primarily hostile and intimidating as is the case spiritual terms the opposite of those of your persona your constructed selfimage for facing the external world if your persona is intellectual your soul image compensates by being emotional and vice versa if your persona is intuitive your soul image will be earthly and sensual and vice versa the result here is that the soul image profoundly represents the other of intrigue in the same way that the unconscious is extremely other from consciousness so is the case with the soul image a new age misinterpretation of encountering the animaanimus is that the goal of this step of individuation is to entirely integrate the soul image and therefore become psychically androgynous and even mixture of masculine and feminine this is not the case in the illuminist interpretation the soul image is intended to be projected outwardly and understood consciously not to be identified with the task of a person with a highly masculine persona is not to diffuse and subdue this energy via the anima the task is to learn from the anima incorporating the aspects of it which make you a stronger person while establishing a more deep connectiondialogue with the collective unconscious stage 3 encounter with the mana personality the successful encounter with the soul image and the establishment of a productive relationship with the unconscious will yield an opportunity to integrate the mana personality of the human collective unconscious mana is a polynesian word which references spiritual or supernatural power the mana personality is a dominant of the collective unconscious which as spiro hamilton said is imbued with extraordinary power and insight and can furnish the greatest spiritual guidance and directions on how to slay a dragon or defeat your demons unlike the soul image being promoted to gandalf the white stage 4 emergence of the self the conclusion of jungian individuation ends with true completion if we manage to successfully integrate our shadow encounter and build rapport with our soul image encounter the mana personality slay every dragon defeat every monster within us and shine the light of consciousness into all the dark corners of the unconscious we have the opportunity to attempt to integrate the self and become psychically whole and balanced spiro hamilton said encountering and integrating the self is the goal of full selfrealization is always calling to us it permeates our dreams and imaginations it is present in all of our ideas of perfection of god everywhere we are attracted to symbols myths and philosophies that depict ideals of wholeness harmony and completion mike hockney introduced the self archetype by saying according to jung the self is transpersonal rather than personal it is therefore not conditioned by a persons individual experiences and does not draw its power from anything other than the collective unconscious the self is the goal of the process of individuation the symbol of perfect completion wholeness alienation from the self has been a disaster and has produced an incredible number of psychological issues mike hockney said negative inflation by complete contrast results in annihilation of the ego gender nonconformity is not new the panic around it is a viral bathroom confrontation involving zachary willmore has reopened conversations about gender expression and who is allowed to exist visibly in public spaces drawing on cultural memory from the 1970s and 1980s this article explores how gender nonconformity has long been part of pop culture why it once provoked panic and how those same fears are now redirected toward transgender people simply trying to live their lives

dating tips ive been getting a few dms asking me to write about dating especially from people who saw my last post on rtamilyapping many of them dont know how to approach someone or even where to begin first thingyou dont need to look like a model you can be an averagelooking guy and still date well what actually matters is how you communicate and how you approach people communication really is the key dating apps r js bs matches are rare and most of them r scammers conversations dont go anywhere and the experience often feels transactional cities like blr and mumbai have a relatively better dating scene while chennai can feel lame its not impossible you just need a different approach find places where people actually spend time nowadays girls arent rlly going to temples anymore so look for places where they genuinely spend most of their time for women yesthere are already plenty of dms for men relying only on online spaces isnt very effective personally i avoid online dating as much as possibleive always found better connections in places aligned with my interests i attend meetups and workshops i have hobbies baking gardening pottery painting drawing music reading and i join spaces related to them that way i meet people who already share a similar mindset and lifestyle i also attend business and tech meetups where i naturally meet people from my own field but heres the important part you still need to know how to talk to people most people are open to getting to know someoneas long as the conversation feels genuine and interesting if youre in college you already have access to friend groups a lot of guys dm me saying i never talked to girls in college but the truth is most of the time youre spending all your energy with your guy friends staying in the same groups and not stepping out of your comfort zone if most of your time is spent scrolling through instagram or youtube shorts you wont magically build connections watching couple reels and feeling jealous wont change anything try joining clubs in your college explore activities dont say i cant find someone you need to put in effortwithout effort you dont get anything try approaching people you wont know what will happen unless you try if you like someone from your college or workplace approach them respectfully if they reject you accept it and move on try again with someone else thats how it works attend workshops explore new hobbies join reading groups r something else learning circles anything youre genuinely interested in thats where real connections form dont depend entirely on online dating go out and build something realrejection will happen thats normal try again shoot your shot if you take 100 shots maybe one or two will land and thats enough if you never try youll likely remain single well into your 30s or 40s one more thing be interesting women are selective and thats not a bad thing even if someone has many options theyll still choose what genuinely suits them be someone she can admire dont chase never chase instead focus on yourself dress well groom yourself maintain good hygiene smell good eat properly work out and take care of your health be different by building a life that feels solid and confident when you respect yourself others naturally notice most of my past relationships and even my current one werent forced i didnt chase i stayed patient showed interest and put in effort where it mattered things developed naturally ive seen my friends date successfully everywhere from chennai to usa uk and singapore im not a manmadha kunju just someone who has seen enough good and bad relationships to learn a few lessons im sharing what worked for me feel free to share your own experiences too lets keep the discussion positive and honest vanakam

how to become 10x more attractive the psychology that actually works no genetics required so i spent the last year obsessing over this why do some people just feel magnetic not supermodel hot just attractive in a way that makes you want to be around them i went down a rabbit hole of psychology research bingewatched charisma breakdowns and read way too many books on human behavior turns out attraction isnt what we think it is most of us are stuck chasing the wrong things we think we need perfect skin a sixpack or better genes but research shows thats maybe 30 of the equation the other 70 completely learnable im talking about presence energy how you make people feel and honestly once i started applying this stuff people treated me differently not overnight but noticeably heres what actually moved the needle stop trying to be liked start being interested this ones from dale carnegies how to win friends and influence people and it sounds stupidly simple but it works the book sold 30 million copies for a reason carnegie was basically the og social skills researcher and his core insight is this people are obsessed with themselves when you genuinely care about what someones saying ask real questions remember details they feel seen thats magnetic i used to dominate conversations without realizing it always waiting for my turn to talk steering things back to me now i actively listen i ask followups i let silences breathe the shift was insane people started saying i was so easy to talk to when literally all i did was shut up and pay attention this book will make you question everything you think you know about making good impressions its a bit oldschool in tone but the psychology is timeless best people skills book ive ever read fix your posture and movement seriously amy cuddys research on body language changed how i see this shes a harvard social psychologist who studies how our physicality affects our psychology and how others perceive us her ted talk on power poses blew up for good reason when you stand tall take up space move deliberately your brain literally releases more testosterone and less cortisol you feel more confident and people pick up on it instantly i started doing two things one i set reminders to check my posture throughout the day shoulders back chin level core engaged two i slowed down my movements no more fidgeting or rushed gestures just calm controlled motion within weeks people started treating me with more respect i got better service at restaurants strangers held doors it sounds crazy but its real for tracking this i actually use an app called finch its a habitbuilding app disguised as a cute bird game but it helped me stay consistent with posture checks and daily movement you set small goals your bird grows and somehow the gamification makes boring habits stick theres also befreed an ai learning app that takes top book summaries research papers and expert talks and turns them into personalized audio podcasts with adaptive learning plans the depth customization is clutch you can do a quick 10minute overview or go deep with a 40minute dive full of examples when something really clicks it pulls from millions of sources everything from research studies to real success stories all factchecked the voice options are honestly addictive you can switch between a calm bedtime voice or something more energetic for workouts plus it has this virtual coach called freedia you can chat with midpodcast if you want to explore ideas deeper worth checking out if youre serious about internalizing this psychology stuff beyond just reading about it master the art of strategic silence this ones counterintuitive we think attractive people are effortlessly charming and always on but chris vosss never split the difference hes a former fbi hostage negotiator taught me that silence is power when youre comfortable with pauses you command attention people lean in they fill the void you become someone worth listening to i started practicing this in conversations instead of rushing to respond id pause for two seconds let the other persons words land then speak the change was wild my words carried more weight people stopped interrupting me i felt more in control of social interactions without being controlling vosss book is technically about negotiation but its secretly a masterclass in human psychology and influence the techniques are based on actual highstakes situations so you know they work under pressure this book made me realize that most of us are trying way too hard in conversations sometimes the most attractive thing you can do is just pause real talk none of this requires you to be extroverted or naturally charismatic im definitely not but these small shifts practiced consistently changed how i show up in the world people respond differently when youre genuinely present physically confident and comfortable with silence its not about faking anything its about removing the static thats hiding who you actually are the science backs this up studies on interpersonal attraction show that traits like attentiveness confident body language and emotional regulation consistently rank higher than physical appearance in longterm attraction were just conditioned to believe otherwise start with one thing pick the tip that feels most doable practice it for two weeks then add another small actions big shifts

sustainable baby toys your little one will love todays conscious parents are increasingly seeking sustainable and ecofriendly options particularly when it comes to toys in this article we will explore some of the best sustainable and ecofriendly baby toys designed to promote sensory play while ensuring a better world for the next generation why choose sustainable baby toys sustainable baby toys are made from ecofriendly materials that are safer for your child and the environment here are a few compelling reasons to select sustainable options healthier for baby traditional toys may contain harmful chemicals while sustainable toys are made from natural nontoxic materials ecofriendly sustainable toys often use renewable resources reduce waste and have a smaller carbon footprint durability many ecofriendly toys are sturdily built from durable materials like solid wood reducing the need for replacements promotes environmental awareness choosing ecofriendly toys sets a responsible example for your little ones about caring for the planet types of ecofriendly baby toys when you start looking for sustainable options youll find a variety of ecofriendly toys from natural wood toys to organic fabric toys the options are plentiful heres a closer look at some popular categories wooden toys plantoys baby key rattle wooden toys are a classic choice and for good reason they are durable safe and can often be passed down through generations when looking for wooden toys ensure they are certified as sustainably sourced such as fsc labels these toys not only have a tactile quality that promotes sensory play for your little one but can also be delightful to look at with their natural grains and textures organic fabric toys senger cuddly animal goose for babies and toddlers organic fabric toys can be a great addition to playtime made from 100 organic cotton or linen a good doll brand is senger naturwelt their animal dolls are soft safe and safe to chew on recycled materials toys toys made from recycled materials are not only kind to the planet but inspiring as well these toys often have unique designs and can help introduce concepts of recycling and sustainability to your child from a young age some toys are composed of recycled plastics while others utilize materials from everyday items that would have otherwise gone to waste how to choose the right sustainable baby toys selecting the right toys for your baby can be overwhelming with so many options available follow these guidelines to make the best choices read labels and certifications always read product labels to ensure toys are made from safe nontoxic materials look for certifications like the global organic textile standard gots for fabric toys or the forest stewardship council fsc certification for wooden toys consider age appropriateness not all toys are suitable for all ages look for ageappropriate toys that match your childs developmental stage many sustainable toys clearly indicate the age range they are designed for helping you make informed choices focus on multifunctionality opt for toys that serve multiple purposes for instance a toy that encourages both sensory play and cognitive skill development will keep your little one entertained longer and provide better value engaging activities with ecofriendly toys once you have your collection of sustainable baby toys its time to have some fun here are a few activities that you can introduce to your baby texture discovery gather a variety of ecofriendly toys with different textures from smooth wooden blocks to soft fabric animals let your baby explore each item describing the textures together this encourages language development and sensory awareness shape sorting fun if you have colorful wooden shapes engage your little one in a shapesorting activity discuss each shapes name while they fit them into corresponding slots promoting problemsolving and fine motor skills through sensory play sound exploration incorporate soundmaking ecofriendly toys into your playtime rattles shakers or instruments made from natural materials can introduce your baby to different sounds encourage your child to shake tap and listen to the unique noise each toy makes safe storage of ecofriendly toys once playtime is over its essential to have a safe storage solution for your sustainable toys to keep your nursery organized here are some ecofriendly storage ideas woven baskets use woven baskets made from organic cotton or recycled materials to keep toys tidy and ready for the next play session wooden crates repurpose wooden crates for a rustic yet charming storage solution for your babys toys hanging organizers utilize wall space with hanging organizers made from sustainable materials to store smaller toys final words choosing sustainable and ecofriendly baby toys nurtures not only your childs growth but also the health of our planet by encouraging sensory play and fostering a love for nature we set the foundation for an environmentally conscious generation as you explore options for your little ones always remember every tiny step toward sustainability counts together we can make a difference for our children and their future read the original article

from a desi boy to a closet femboy finding myself in georgia ive been reading posts here for a while and today i finally felt ready to share a bit of my own story i grew up as a desi indian boy and from a very young age i understood that there were certain expectations placed on mehow i should act how i should dress how i should be manly i didnt question it much back then i just learned to adjust and keep parts of myself quiet but even as a teenager i always felt this softness in me a curiosity a side that didnt fit neatly into the box i was given i didnt know what to call it and honestly i didnt think i was allowed to explore it things slowly changed after moving to georgia being away from home gave me space physical and emotional to breathe i started noticing how good it felt to let myself be a little more feminine at first it was very private small things safe things thats how my closet femboy identity started quietly without any big announcements what surprised me the most was how this exploration changed my confidence embracing my feminine side didnt make me feel weak it actually made me feel more comfortable in my skin i became more expressive more playful and more open in how i interact with people i found myself enjoying attention enjoying gentle teasing and feeling attractive in a way i never allowed myself to before with men and other genders im still discreet im still figuring things out i dont have all the answers or a perfect label but i do know that allowing myself to be soft curious and a little playful has helped me feel more real than i ever did when i was pretending if youre reading this and you come from a background or culture that makes exploration feel scary or confusing youre not broken youre not late youre not wrong sometimes growth happens quietly behind closed doors until were ready to name it thanks for reading and thanks for giving me a space where stories like this are welcome

crypto stopped asking what else can this do and started asking how do we package this for finance early crypto didnt start with the idea of etfs custodians or digital gold narratives it started with a much simpler and more dangerous question what happens if money no longer needs permission from that came mining as participation selfcustody censorship resistance and experimentation people ran nodes mined coins broke things and tried new ideas not because it was efficient but because it was possible somewhere along the way the question changed instead of asking what else crypto can do the space started asking how do we package this for finance how do we make it etffriendly custodyfriendly regulatorfriendly and narrativefriendly mining became obsolete selfcustody became inconvenient privacy became optional and innovation narrowed into whatever fits existing financial rails this isnt a moral judgment its just an observation thats why projects like zeroclassic zerc exist zeroclassic isnt trying to replace bitcoin or monero and its not chasing institutional adoption its exploring unfinished questions from cryptos early days what if proofofwork secured more than just payments what if private money and private communication shared the same trustless foundation what if participation mining usage mattered as much as holding zerc is a gpumined pow chain with zksnark privacy and no dev fee but the more interesting part is its direction freedom of chat public discussion using transparent addresses and private coordination using shielded transactions no accounts no platforms no moderators with admin keys just keys rules and math it may not be the most efficient path it may never be the most popular but it asks a question that feels increasingly relevant as trust in institutions platforms and debtbased systems erodes what is crypto for if not to give individuals control not just over money but over coordination and freedom curious how others here see it has crypto matured or has it narrowed
