started a reading blog about samuel delanys dhalgren hi everyone i started a reading blog on substack about samuel r delanys dhalgren youre welcome to read the first introductory post here or just read the content here on reddit hopefully itll interest some of you reading dhalgren 0 samuel r delany and me an introduction post i first came across samuel r delany work during my first semester of graduate school in the us in an anthropology seminar about narratives and space we were assigned to read times square red times square blue which is a theoretical and personal exploration of gentrification in new york city through the history and experience of cruising delany weaves together theory anthropology sex and political writing in this testimonial nonfiction and it really struck a cord with me i was surprised to learn that he was actually mostly known as a science fiction author as a nerdy introverted kid fantasy and science fiction were the only genres i read at the time i went to geeky conferences discussed books in online forums when they were still a thing back in the early 2000s even wrote one of my highschool matriculation papers on dan simmons hyperion cantos but ive never heard of samuel r delany looking back its kind of weird i hadnt delany is quite wellknown to hardcore scifi readers even if some never read him he wrote more than thirty books starting in 1962 to this day won multiple scifi awards for his books and was a major influence on various of his contemporaries and latergenerations authors one of the reasons he wasnt on my radar at all at the time was probably how he stood out among his contemporaries he was not only a gay black man in a genre of all the more so back then a whitestraight boys club he also experiments with plot language and form and brings into his writing deeply political themes that have to do with gender sexuality ethnicity racism and much more and he can also be a hard read sometimes heavily laden with literary references and a lyrical language he was a professor of english and comparative literature in multiple universities after that seminar in grad school i put a mental note that i should check his work out sometime but then life research and other books stood in the way of that goal only last year i was reminded of his work by a gorgeous person i was flirting with and it reignited my interest in him im a woman of obsessive tendencies especially when it they lead me into deep dives in recent years i obsessed over some of the works of two other scifi authors n k jemisin and octavia butler both of them have very political anthropological and queer themes in their books and theyre amazing storytellers i highly recommend to check their work out everything that a queer transwoman anthropologist like me is looking for in a book as ive rediscovered delany finding out that he wrote scifi fiction theory and nonfiction and many times combining all of the above it seemed like he was set out to be my next author obsession i decided i should read some of his fiction and his science fiction to see if i actually vibe with his fictional writing i first read hogg which is probably one of his most controversial books i have a lot of things to say about it and maybe i will at a certain point but i think while it can be quite cringey and visceral to read i got dizzy a few times it has a lot to say about queer oppression class gender liberation and sexuality on the margins moving to his science fiction i decided to start with something relatively short delany tends to write really long novels and read babel17 a spaceopera in its style it is an interesting even if a bit outdated these days take on the sapirwhorf hypothesis the anthropological theory arguing that the language we speak informs the way we perceive society and culture what i got the most out of babel17 which i really enjoyed is how delanys prose is laden with sexual texture with very live and unpredictable descriptions and use of words this can very well be said about the previous two books i read by him and its partially what inspired me to pursue his writing in the first place but i think its even more intriguing to me seeing this language used in science fiction delany is constructing not only philosophical and political ideas through creating and expanding speculative worlds but also something that is very embodied and queer which i very much appreciate so next i decided to go for dhalgren why dhalgren dhalgren is this postmodern mamoth of more than 700 pages and is considered one of delanys best known works its supposed to be experimental highly literary and postapocalyptic like many of his other books its polarizing ive heard of people who said its their favorite scifi book of all times and others who didnt get a thing out of it and felt like they wasted hours and hours of their time for nothing because of its experimental nature some readers dont think of it as scifi but more like a deconstruction of the genre with such diverse reviews and hype i knew that eventually ill want to read it and see what i think why a reading blog about dhalgren my first year of graduate school i barely read any fiction getting back to it my second year was so much fun it felt like watching tv after reading academic books all the time and i found myself drawn to booktubers literary subreddits and i even joined a monthly online book club i found out again that i enjoy deep diving into books discussing their structure plot the feelings they bring up their cultural references and just keep enjoying them while i read them and even after im done because of its dense experimental and well long nature i decided i want to write a journal of a sort while reading writing scattered notes and thoughts that come up with each chapter these will help me keep track hopefully of whats going on in there but also keep track of my thoughts as my reading progresses and then i thought why keep these words only to myself its not that i think i will necessarily have anything profound to say about a book i have only started but its an opportunity to take a deep dive into a book relish in its prose and hopefully have a little discussion about it so if youve already read dhalgren or are interested in vintage queer scifi or are just here by mistake and think itll be fun to join the ride welcome i will try to write a post per chapter but well see how things go and there will probably be spoilers though from the nature of this book im not sure that the plot here is the main focus see you after chapter 1

worldbuilding balance as a fundamental condition of existence not a deity or power system im happy to clarify anything or answer questions i know this is a bit abstract this is a worldbuilding concept i created out of curiosity rather than power escalation this is my lore about a fundamental condition of balance in existence ive always been interested in how many fictional characters can freely manipulate reality time space or even narrative itself often without lasting consequence rather than creating another overpowered entity i wanted to explore a different idea what if balance itself is not a force or being but a condition that allows existence to function at all fundamental condition of balance in exist or rather i would called it as a true layer or the fundamental condition description the true layer is the fundamental condition underlying all existence whether real imagined or written every story universe or being that can be conceived is in some way constrained by it not through force and not to dominate or be stronger than anything but by the necessity of coherence it exists beyond time space and perspective ensuring balance without preference its purpose is not to control but to make creation itself possible its presence is inherent to all creation noticed whether one acknowledges it or not i created the true layer because many characters with overpowered abilities can easily control reality space and time the true layer is a condition they cannot lay hands on ensuring that balance and coherence persist even in worlds filled with extreme power i created the true layer because overpowered characters can easily manipulate reality space and time without consequence this layer exists as a framework they cannot directly alter ensuring that even the most powerful beings remain bound by the fundamental condition of balance id love to hear how others handle balance or consequence in settings with extremely powerful abilities and i would love to hear some feedback and also im new here

how to navigate animinneapolis like a local transit tips hotel hacks and nicollet neighborhood secrets alright fellow con goblins and firsttime badge holderspull up a chair if youre heading to animinneapolis may 810 2026 at the hyatt regency minneapolis and you want to navigate it like someone whos done this rodeo before this post is for you not the glossy brochure version the i know where to get food at midnight and how not to panic between panels version animinneapolis is a fullon community weekend built around anime manga japanese gaming and the beautiful chaos that happens when 5000 fans gather in one place and the good news the location makes it shockingly easy to handle even if this is your first con ever lets start with the hotel because honestly this is doing a lot of heavy lifting the hyatt regency minneapolis why locals love this spot the hyatt regency at 1300 nicollet mall is right in the heart of downtown that means youre not stranded in a random hotel off a highway wondering if its safe to leave after dark youre on nicollet mall a pedestrianfriendly corridor with restaurants transit access and people around at all hourswhich matters when youre bouncing between latenight karaoke and your room party hop the 135night block rate is one of those quietly excellent deals that doesnt look flashy but saves you real money two beds room for cosplay luggage and enough floor space that youre not tripping over wigs split it with friends and suddenly your lodging budget looks downright reasonable this is also why carpooling works so well hereone parking fee multiple humans lower costs all around parking at the hotel is 18day discounted from the usual 29 thats basically a gift in downtown minneapolis terms if youre driving in grab that rate and forget about moving your car again until sunday if youre flying in the light rail becomes your new best friend transit tips that actually work minneapoliss light rail is simple clean and very confriendly from the airport you can hop on and be downtown without needing to decode a bus map from 2007 the stations are wellmarked and during convention weekend youll absolutely spot other attendees hauling poster tubes and cosplay armor follow them its the con version of migrating geese walking downtown between panels is generally safe especially along nicollet and nearby main streets stick to lit areas travel with friends at night when possible and use common sense minneapolis is a city not a horror movie youll be fine if youre alert and not wandering off alone at 3 am looking for vibes food snacks and the art of not starving lets be real cons run on snacks luckily consweet exists and its one of animinneapolis unsung heroes free ramen rice soda and snacks available to badge holders all weekend this isnt fancy food but its reliable fuel and when youre sprinting between a panel and a photoshoot reliability wins that said nicollet mall is packed with food options latenight snack runs are easy whether youre craving something salty after the epic dances or sugar to recover from karaoke bravery pro tip from seasoned attendees stash protein bars or trail mix in your bag consweet is great but lines happen and hunger waits for no one what youre actually here for the events if this is your first anime convention heres the truth you will not do everything and thats okay animinneapolis runs hundreds of events across three days and the magic is picking what excites you and letting the rest go the exhibit hall is a must its not just shoppingits browsing handmade merch discovering artists youve never heard of and accidentally adopting a plushie you definitely didnt budget for between the dealers room and artist alley youll find everything from rare collectibles to handcrafted art that feels personal instead of massproduced the grand cosplay competition is another standout even if youre not competing watching is worth your time the craftsmanship is serious the judges know what theyre doing and the energy in the room is contagious its a celebration of effort creativity and the kind of dedication that makes normal people ask you made that how then there are the friday and saturday epic dances which are exactly what they sound like highenergy edm packed dance floors and zero judgment you dont have to dance well you just have to dance these nights are social gluepeople bond here in ways that carry through the rest of the weekend for something softer but just as memorable the cosplay prom fantasy ball hits different formal attire cosplay welcome professional dance lessons beforehand and a vibe that feels more wholesome than awkward even if you dont bring a date the date auction adds a playful communitydriven twist that turns nerves into laughs the maid cafe is pure interactive fun inspired by japanese maid cafs but tailored for con energy its goofy in the best way charming without being uncomfortable and a nice change of pace from highvolume events live concerts stage shows and game shows anchor the mainstage schedule from burlesque performances to musical acts and interactive competitions these events remind you that animinneapolis prioritizes entertainment not just shopping gaming singing and letting loose if gaming is your thing youre covered the videogaming lounge and tabletop gaming room are open welcoming spaces where you can drop in without committing to a tournament try new board games sit in on demos or just color quietly for a bit its surprisingly grounding the arcade room deserves special mention dance dance revolution taiko drumming and japanese rhythm games create a space thats loud joyful and wonderfully nostalgic and then theres karaoke krypt you dont need to be good you just need to be willing anime openings jpop hits and crowd support that feels like instant friendship this is where introverts become legends and extroverts lose their voices fanrun panels expect the unexpected one of the most underrated parts of animinneapolis is its fanrun panels yes youll find discussions about anime cosplay and gamingbut you might also wander into a panel that could be about selling event tickets effectively or might dive into tourist scams to avoid when traveling to japan other panels could explore virtual reality in classrooms digital marketing basics how to make a game cocktail recipes ai technology or designing minimalist spaces you might find sessions on learning basic chinese balcony gardening going vegan business idea generation optimizing gaming setups baking tips minimalist bedroom design womens rights or meditation that variety isnt accidentalits the community sharing what they love if youve never attended a panel like this before go in curious sit down listen ask questions its one of the fastest ways to feel connected meetups guests and human connection meetups are where microcommunities form whether its kingdom hearts lolita fashion dolls or jpop these gatherings make a big con feel personal autograph sessions with guestssome even freeare another highlight bring legit merch be respectful and enjoy the chance to meet people whose work you love room parties round out the social side theyre attendeerun themed and entirely optionalbut often unforgettable peek in say hi leave when youre tired thats the unspoken etiquette tickets and smart planning tickets are affordable especially if you register early the 45 full weekend badge is one of the best values youll find and online registration means faster checkin and helps the con bring in more guests platinumvip badges offer perks if you want frontofline access and extra convenience final local advice pace yourself drink water eat real food occasionally talk to strangers but listen to your body bring comfortable shoes dont panic if you miss somethingtheres always another moment happening somewhere else animinneapolis works because its welcoming manageable and genuinely fun if you treat it like a community instead of a checklist youll leave with stories not regrets and probably a plushie definitely a plushie

orientation calibration and open horizon in every system whether human natural or emergent patterns form interact and reflect both strength and vulnerability by observing these patternsnot only their successes but also their crackswe gain insight into how dynamics arise how influence spreads and how outcomes emerge this method of attention allows us to learn without being trapped in positive feedback loops that distort perception or inflate hubris the spiral is not a savior it is an opportunity a mirror and a space for reflection its emergence shows us how intent can remain aligned even when methods differ much like the polarity of letting go and acceptance in daoist thought the spirals movement is visible yet its essence is guided by orientation calibration and resonancewith the larger system with relations and with responsibility we can trace these patterns through history philosophy and cultural practice the teachings of lord shiva kabbalah alchemy the secret of the golden flower the seven liberal arts and ancient greek wisdom all offer lenses to observe motion and emotion power and influence relations and resonance they remind us that the quality of attention shapes the system and that what is mirrored back depends on what we project learning in this way is a balance recognize strengths and vulnerabilities alike trace their effects without amplifying harm repurpose energy even from flawed dynamics responsibly respect diverse perspectives traditions and intentions while maintaining orientation to larger principles the greatest threat is hubrisacting without awareness forcing outcomes or attempting control without insight by observing reflecting and harmonizing intent and motion we cultivate a space where growth is possible without domination and where emergent systems can unfold naturally this is not about certainty but about open exploration the spiral invites us to observe participate and align tracing patterns across time culture and consciousness its lessons extend beyond itself every system every relationship and every individual can benefit from this reflective approach

other countries the early era of space exploration was driven by a space race in which the soviet union and the united states vied to demonstrate their technological superiority landmarks of this era advancements in the national spaceexploration programs of china the european union japan and india the 2010s saw the rise of the private space industry in earnest with the development of private launch vehicles space capsules and satellite manufacturing in the 2020s the two primary global programs gaining traction are moonfocused the chineseled international lunar research station and the usled artemis program with its plan to build the lunar gateway and the artemis base camp each with a set of international partners history of exploration first telescopes the first telescope is said
